class.name: LandscapeRoadMaterial
class.description: A road shader made for the meshes of [LandscapeSpline3D] roads, which works without any texture: - Procedural surface: aggregate grain, large patches and wheel tracks, multiplied with the optional [member albedo_texture] and [member normal_texture]. - Lane markings: edge lines, dashed lines between the lanes and a configurable center line. - Dirt along the edges, which are irregular and blend into the terrain (alpha scissor). - Wet surface and puddles. Use [method apply_preset] to switch between asphalt, dirt and gravel roads.

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Resets the parameters (except the textures) to the values of [param preset].

method.name: get_builtin_shader_code
method.description: Returns the code of the built-in road shader.

members.member: Base color of the road.
Optional albedo texture, multiplied with [member albedo_color].
The line in the middle of roads with an even [member lane_count]: [code]0[/code] none, [code]1[/code] dashed, [code]2[/code] solid, [code]3[/code] double solid.
Color of the center line (e.g. yellow).
Gap between the dashes of the dashed lines.
Length of the dashes of the dashed lines.
Color of the dirt along the edges of the road and on its skirts.
Distance between the edge lines and the edges of the road.
Irregularity of the edges of the road and of the dirt along them.
Width of the dirt along the edges of the road.
Contrast of the procedural aggregate grain.
Size of the procedural aggregate grain.
Number of lanes, separated by dashed lines (and the [member center_line] in the middle).
If [code]true[/code], lane markings are painted on the road.
Color of the lane markings.
Width of the lane markings.
Strength of [member normal_texture].
Optional normal map.
Amount of puddles on the road.
Roughness of the dry road.
Size of the textures: [code]x[/code] across the road ([code]1[/code] is the width of the road), [code]y[/code] along the road, in meters.
Wear of the road: darker wheel tracks and worn lane markings.
Wetness of the road: darker and glossier surface.

constants.constant: Asphalt road with lane markings (default parameters).
Dirt road with ruts, without markings.
